title: Two ways into one JVM client: a javaagent for the gate, a hijacked DLL for the launch
summary: The entitlement decision is one null check on a licence object, so a javaagent that rewrites three methods opens every paid module without touching the jar. The same jar is also reachable earlier: the JVM's native dependencies are imported from a user-writable directory, so a forwarded proxy DLL injects the agent without any configuration at all.
